description: Latency and reliability of the paths a recipient and a sender actually wait on.

metrics.description: 95th percentile time to assemble the evidence for a question.
metrics.measurementMethod: Measured from question receipt to the retrieved passage set being ready, including the question embedding.

metrics.description: 95th percentile total time from question to displayed answer.
metrics.measurementMethod: Measured end to end across the answer path and recorded on the usage ledger.

metrics.description: Share of processing jobs that complete without exhausting their retries.
metrics.measurementMethod: Completed jobs divided by terminal jobs over the window, per job type.

metrics.description: Jobs that have been running far longer than their type's 99th percentile.
metrics.measurementMethod: Count jobs in RUNNING whose start is older than ten times the type's P99 duration, or older than thirty minutes when no history exists.

metrics.description: At least one worker has reported a heartbeat recently.
metrics.measurementMethod: 1 when a worker heartbeat is newer than sixty seconds, otherwise 0.
